concerns.text: The plan cites the LIGO O3 PSD dataset via the URL `https://huggingface.co/datasets/astro-legacy-archive/gwosc-o3a-strain/resolve/main/H1-1238163456-1238216704-DQmask.parquet`. This Hugging Face asset contains raw strain time‑series data, not a pre‑computed power‑spectral‑density (PSD) required for noise injection as specified in FR‑002. Using a strain segment instead of a PSD would invalidate the noise model and thus the quantization‑impact analysis.
